speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Freight lift arrived at Spire Level 100. Elevation: four-thousand five-hundred meters. Atmospheric pressure critical. Welcome to the Apex Bastion—the personal fortress of the Praetorian Guard.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Look at these battlements... obsidian-alloy plating three meters thick. Automated plasma turrets tracking every inch of the courtyard. They've turned the entire spire summit into an active warzone.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: The clouds are beneath us now. Sub-zero gale-force winds are whipping across the ramparts. One slip off these outer parapets and it's a four-kilometer drop back to the city.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Motion sensors pinging dozens of heavy signatures. Those aren't automated drones—those are the Void Commander's elite Praetorian shock-troopers and cyber-samurai. They're locked and loaded.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: Their comms are chillingly silent. No panic, no distress calls. They know the Cyber-Nexus is gone, and they know we're here. They have sworn an oath to fight to the last machine cycle.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: The stairway beyond the courtyard leads directly to the Throne Room. Look at the perimeter gate: heavy barrier shields and heavy kinetic artillery. We will need all our strength to breach it.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Warning: Deep scans detect a colossal mechanized war chassis guarding the grand gatehouse: The Bastion Praetor. It is the final guardian defending access to the Void Commander.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: We broke their street gangs in the District. We drowned their bio-labs in the Grave. We tore their sky-shields down in the Forge. We are not stopping on the front porch.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Axiom Force has come too far to falter. Through the Praetorian Guard, through the Praetor mech, and straight to the Void Commander's throne. Blades drawn—breach the Bastion!
